name: ChoiceMate AI – Guided Selling & Product Finder for WooCommerce
author: velocityplugins

sections.description:
Are you losing sales because customers get overwhelmed by your product selection?

Choice paralysis is real. When customers can’t decide, they leave your store, often for good. ChoiceMate AI solves this problem by transforming your WooCommerce shop into a consultative, guided selling experience.

Our plugin creates an interactive product finder—a smart quiz—that asks customers simple questions about their needs. Just like a top-tier salesperson, it instantly analyzes their answers and presents them with the perfect products, complete with a reason why it’s the right choice for them.

Stop guessing and start guiding. Increase conversions, reduce returns, and build lasting customer loyalty by making shopping easy and personal.

Why You’ll Love ChoiceMate AI

  • 🚀 Boost Conversions Instantly
    By replacing confusion with confidence, you’ll guide more customers from browsing to buying. Drastically reduce cart abandonment by showing shoppers exactly what they’re looking for.

  • 🧠 Effortless AI-Powered Setup
    No need to manually create complex decision trees. Our AI analyzes your WooCommerce products (attributes, categories, metadata) and generates a smart, effective question flow in minutes. You get a powerful result with minimal effort.

  • 💡 Unlock Actionable Customer Insights
    Our analytics dashboard isn’t just a set of numbers. It’s a goldmine of customer intelligence. Discover what your customers truly want, which features are most important to them, and optimize your marketing and inventory based on real data.

  • 🎨 Fully Customizable to Match Your Brand
    You have complete control over the look and feel. Customize all text, colors, and styles from an intuitive interface to ensure the product finder seamlessly integrates with your theme and brand identity.

  • ⚙️ Built for Speed & Stability
    Site performance is non-negotiable. ChoiceMate AI is built 100% on the WordPress native stack, using React (wp-element). It loads no external CDNs or third-party libraries that slow you down. It’s lightweight, fast, and reliable.

  • ✅ Modern WooCommerce Ready
    ChoiceMate AI is fully compatible with the latest WooCommerce features, including HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage), ensuring smooth, scalable performance for stores of all sizes.
sections.installation:
1. Navigate to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “ChoiceMate AI Product Finder”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. You’ll see a new menu item: ChoiceMate AI. Go to ChoiceMate AI > Settings to enter your OpenAI API key.
  5. You’re ready! Click “Create New Flow” to let the AI build your first interactive product finder.
sections.faq:
Is an OpenAI API key required?

Yes, the AI-powered features rely on the OpenAI API. You can get your own API key from platform.openai.com. The setup is quick, and our plugin includes a “Test Connection” button to ensure everything is working correctly.

Will this slow down my website?

No. We’ve obsessed over performance. All heavy AI processing happens externally via the API. The frontend interface is a lightweight React application that is incredibly fast and won’t impact your Core Web Vitals.

Will this work with my theme?

Yes. ChoiceMate AI is designed to be theme-agnostic and works with any standard WooCommerce theme. The widget can be placed anywhere using a shortcode or Gutenberg block, and its appearance is fully customizable to match your design.

Can I edit the AI-generated questions?

Absolutely. The AI gives you a powerful head start, but you always have the final say. You can easily add, edit, or reorder questions and answers from our intuitive flow builder to perfectly fine-tune the customer experience.
